capabilities: Drag and drop widgets within a grid pane
Resize widgets with drag handles and snap-to-grid
Render markdown, images, pages, and countdowns inside widgets
Duplicate widgets and switch between transparent and standard modes
Open a Bento Grid pane from the sidebar button
extras: README lists open TODOs, including improving markdown rendering and fixing rendering problems; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to arrange mixed content like notes, images, and countdowns into a fixed, customizable dashboard layout inside a pane.
summary: Bento-style grid pane whose draggable, resizable widgets render markdown, images, pages, and countdowns as a personal dashboard.
